mcp.sessionMode: one fresh MCP server per request; no Mcp-Session-Id

security.mode: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE/DCR for /mcp; static bearer for private /api routes
security.processing: Create/rebuild sends memory chunks to Workers AI; semantic/hybrid recall sends query text. Keyword recall and previews do not call AI.
security.warning: Lab only: one owner approval secret, no tenant isolation, rate limiting, or public-write safety controls.
